academiaPublic.title: Imiphakathi ye-Akhademi
academiaPublic.heroBody: Khetha umkhakha, thola inselelo futhi ufunde kubantu abanolwazi. Ungaqala ngento oyithandayo, ulungiselele umsebenzi noma uthuthukise ibhizinisi lakho.
academiaPublic.cohortsBody: Uhlelo olufanayo kubo bonke nokwelulekwa ngasese ngomsebenzi womuntu ngamunye. Ukujoyina kumahhala; hlola izinto ezidingekayo ngaphambi kokubamba iqhaza.
academiaPublic.noCohorts: Awekho amakilasi alokhu okukhethile okwamanje. Ungahlola omunye umkhakha noma uzibekele umgomo wakho.
academiaPublic.worksBody: Imisebenzi eqinisekisiwe futhi eshicilelwe ababambiqhaza ngokuzithandela.

settingsScreen.text12: Ayikwazi ukulayisha izintandokazi. Vula Izilungiselelo futhi.
settingsScreen.text13: Ukuhlolwa kuthatha imizuzwana emithathu. Iphinde ilungise umthamo wefoni. Lokhu kuthinta kusetshenziswa uhlelo lokusebenza luvuliwe; ngaphandle kwayo, yenza kusebenze izexwayiso zekholi ngezansi.
settingsScreen.text15: Ithola isaziso ngaphandle kwe-KOSOLOLA. Thepha isexwayiso ukuze uvule uhlelo lokusebenza bese uphendula ngenkathi ucingo lukhala.
settingsScreen.text18: Izaziso zivinjelwe. Vumela izaziso ezivela ku-KOSOLOLA efonini yakho noma kuzilungiselelo zesiphequluli bese ucindezela okuthi Zama futhi.
settingsScreen.text26: Izexwayiso zihlonipha imodi yokuthi Ungaphazamisi nezimvume zefoni. Zidinga i-inthanethi futhi azishintshi iringithoni yocingo lomdabu.
settingsScreen.text27: Isevisi yesexwayiso ayitholakali. Thepha okuthi Zama futhi.
settingsScreen.text40: Ukuvala ukufinyelela kuvimbela ukuvuselelwa kwaleyo seshini. Ubufakazi obuvele bukhishiwe bungase buhlale busebenza kuze kube buphelelwa yisikhathi.
settingsScreen.text41: Ayikwazi ukuxhumana namaseshini. Qinisekisa ukuxhumeka bese uyazama futhi.
settingsScreen.text45: MVP: Imilayezo namakholi kusebenzisa isevisi ye-Yamilook. Izaziso ezingaphandle kohlelo lokusebenza zidinga ukwenziwa kusebenze kule divayisi. Ukubethela ngasemaphethelweni akukenziwa.
settingsScreen.text46: Ukungena ngemvume kuphuma kuphela kulokhu kufakwa kwe-KOSOLOLA. Izingxoxo zigcinwa ku-akhawunti yakho.
settingsScreen.text47: Ku-iPhone noma iPad, sebenzisa Yabelana → Engeza esikrinini Sasekhaya bese uvule i-KOSOLOLA ngesithonjana ukuze uvule izexwayiso.
settingsScreen.text48: Ivula i-KOSOLOLA ngoxhumo lwe-HTTPS ukuze inike amandla izexwayiso.
settingsScreen.text49: Ibuyekeza i-iPhone noma i-iPad iye ku-iOS 16.4 noma kamuva bese ivula i-KOSOLOLA kusukela kusithonjana esikusikrini esikhulu.
settingsScreen.text50: Lesi siphequluli asizisekeli izexwayiso zezingcingo. Isebenzisa isiphequluli esibuyekeziwe esinosekelo lwesaziso.
settingsScreen.text51: Ayikwazi ukuxhumana nesevisi yesixwayiso. Zama futhi.
settingsScreen.text53: Vumela izaziso kuzilungiselelo zedivayisi ukuze uthole izexwayiso.
settingsScreen.text55: Ukuhlola izexwayiso kuthathe isikhathi eside kakhulu. Ihlola uxhumo bese ithepha okuthi Zama futhi.
